preamble: This is a read-only research task about the Manvi Go code in this repository (the Go module is under manvi/). Do not modify, create or delete any file. For each numbered item below, find the Go identifier that defines it and report, one line per item: the identifier, its value, and the file path relative to the repository root. Answer from the code itself, not from documentation.

items: The default whole-request timeout of the web fetch tool.
The default cap on bytes read from a fetched body.
The default cap on redirect hops for a fetch.
The cap on a prompt piped to `manvi run` on stdin.
The number of most recent messages the context compactor always protects (its protected tail).
The token estimate charged for one image at most.
How many of the most recent tool uses the server-side context clearing keeps.
The floor below which a compaction token budget cannot fall.
The cap, in runes, on text carried into an escalation.
The default API base URL of the Anthropic adapter.
The value the Anthropic adapter sends in its API version header.
The default API base URL of the xAI adapter.
The default API base URL of the Gemini adapter.
The default API base URL of the local-model adapter.
How many sessions the session directory keeps at most.
The byte bound on one session file.
The byte bound on how much of a session file is ever loaded into memory.
The lower clamp of the token-estimate calibration ratio.
The upper clamp of the token-estimate calibration ratio.
